result.decision_rationale: All three candidate-bound gates passed, and the PR #2 records demonstrate real Opus/Astra correction cycles. A relative state root can still cause helpers to lose a live enrollment and allow its ownership claim to be replaced. The final checkpoint also needs verifiable evidence of the live handoff, corrected run counts, and a reachable operating guide with safe shutdown instructions.

source_inspection_only: Traced a relative --state-root from enrollment into both ownership claims and then through helper lookup and replacement enrollment.

Traced the bounded PR-view wait and the branch-head recheck, and compared the documented install and stop behavior with their CLI implementations.

findings.actual: Enrollment stores the relative folder in both claims. find_enrollment resolves it against each caller's current directory. A helper can therefore fail to find state.json. A later enroll from another directory also skips the active-status check when that relative path appears absent, allowing replacement of the live claim.
findings.blocking_rationale: This breaks normal headless validation and durable single-writer ownership using an accepted CLI option.
findings.expected: The controller and developer helpers should resolve the same enrollment from any working directory. An existing claim with unverifiable state should stop replacement.
findings.requested_correction: Resolve the state root to an absolute path before deriving any enrollment paths. Refuse to replace an existing claim when its prior enrollment state cannot be established.
findings.requested_evidence: Enroll in a temporary Git repository with a relative state root, resolve the enrollment from the developer worktree, and attempt a second enrollment from another directory. Verify that the helper finds the original state and that the original claim survives.
findings.title: A relative state root makes enrollment ownership depend on the caller's directory
findings.trigger: Run enroll with a relative --state-root from outside the developer worktree, then use an enrollment helper from the worktree.

findings.actual: The protocol links to docs/AGENT-REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md, which is absent from H. The substantive guide exists at agent_review/README.md. The reference to a guide on tabletop PR #194 does not resolve the link in this repository.

findings.expected: An operator following the local protocol's operating-guide link should reach the instructions for this controller.
findings.requested_correction: Add the contracted docs/AGENT-REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md entry point. It can link directly to the maintained sections of agent_review/README.md so there is one source of operating instructions.

findings.title: The protocol's operating-guide link is broken

findings.actual: The guide says install refuses while any controller holds a lock, although the versioned-install test explicitly installs successfully under a run lock. It also allows deletion of the installation, state and claims after stop. The stop command returns immediately after writing a request. A developer may still need the pinned helper and state to restore, push, or pause.
findings.blocking_rationale: Following the disable instructions can remove the files a live enrollment needs to finish safely or resume.
findings.expected: The guide should describe immutable side-by-side installation and give operators an observable safe boundary before removing helpers, state, or claims.
findings.requested_correction: Document the actual install behavior and reserve activation for an explicit between-run decision. For disable, wait for the stop to take effect and the developer and any runtime transaction to finish. Preserve resumable state on pause and distinguish permanent cancellation and cleanup.
findings.requested_evidence: Check the revised instructions against the existing versioned-install, stop/resume, and cancellation tests, including cancellation refusal during active runtime work.
findings.title: The disable procedure permits cleanup while the developer is still running
findings.trigger: Follow the install and disable section while a headless enrollment is developing or restoring a runtime transaction.

summary.delivered_behavior: The candidate provides the reusable controller, model and permission profiles, project configurations, behavior suite, and Black Tentacles checkpoint plan. Recorded gates demonstrate real model invocation and permission isolation. The PR #2 archive documents genuine findings, corrective commits, rereviews, and a published final Astra verdict.
remaining_owner_review: After the checkpoint passes, the owner decides whether to accept, merge, and install the reviewed setup and when to start Black Tentacles.
summary.scope_reviewed: Final setup for draft PR #1, including controller-core behavior, operating instructions, the live pilot, and the prepared Black Tentacles binding.
